svg.title: The explorer's kit
svg.desc: A map legend of technologies. Mobile: Kotlin, Flutter, Android Jetpack, Dart, CameraX & ML Kit, Bloc & Riverpod; Backend & web: C#, Flask, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, SignalR, React & TypeScript; Data science & ML: Python, scikit-learn, pandas & NumPy, TensorFlow & Keras, ARIMA & GARCH, XGBoost & CatBoost; Storage & cloud: SQL Server, Firebase, PostgreSQL, Cloud Functions, SQLite, Gemini API.
